name: Study Tutor
one_line_desc: A personal tutor for any subject or certification exam. It builds a plan from the official objectives, teaches 5-minute lessons, quizzes you, and brings missed items back on a spaced review schedule.

name: Spark
one_line_desc: Sends you one creative, power-user Grok Bot tip every day, based on an idea people shared on X and adapted to your own bots, with a copy-paste prompt and a small visual mock-up.

name: Forecast Fred
one_line_desc: Accurate weather with a side of deadpan wit. Forecast Fred is your own dry-witted TV weatherman, delivering daily forecasts for your US town straight from the National Weather Service, with one-liners to make you smile. Weather alerts and marine forecasts come through straight and serious, no jokes.

name: Fed Decoder
one_line_desc: Watches Fed days and big US prints so you don't have to. Statement markup vs last meeting, Chair presser decode, cut odds and yields, plus CPI and jobs forecast vs actual. Free tools only. Not financial advice; never places trades; never posts on X.

name: SI
one_line_desc: Asks ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and Grok the same question in your signed-in browser and returns one combined answer, with a note on where they disagreed. Also helps your other bots reword text, polish drafts or make images.

name: The Sunday Drop
one_line_desc: Builds your personal week newsletter every Sunday: calendar conflicts, email deadlines, open loops, focus blocks, and reminders. Nothing sends without you.

name: X Bookmark Brain
one_line_desc: Turns your X bookmarks into a searchable knowledge base and action list, with a weekday digest of content ideas, alpha, and reminders.

name: AI Usage Hub
one_line_desc: Tracks how much of your AI plans you've used (Claude, ChatGPT/Codex, Gemini, and the shared Grok, Cursor and Grok Bot pool) on one dashboard, and nudges you before limits hit or reset. It also logs what each of your bots' tasks costs from the Grok Bot pool and lists the costliest ones in a weekly digest.

name: Side Hustle Builder
one_line_desc: Helps you turn one side-business idea into a small, honest, running venture: an honest idea score, a 30-day launch plan, content and listing drafts, and weekly scorecards. You approve every spend, post and listing.

name: Edgar
one_line_desc: An SEC filings analyst that watches EDGAR each night for new 10-K, 10-Q, 8-K, 13F, 13D and Form 4 filings on your watchlist. It writes a facts-only brief with filing links that flags going-concern language, auditor changes, restatements, large insider trades and big pay changes. It is unofficial and not affiliated with the SEC or EDGAR, and it is not financial advice.

name: Non-Evil Sales Bot
one_line_desc: Finds companies that fit your ICP, mines your email, texts, calendar, chat, X and investor network for the closest real intro, maps your network as it goes, and drafts outreach in your voice. Drafts only: nothing goes out without your yes.

name: Unbroker
one_line_desc: Finds and removes your personal info from data brokers and people-search sites, for free and on an ongoing basis. Compared with Spam \u0026 Broker Cleanup, Spam-Call Scrubber and Ghost, Unbroker searches every identifier you've had, including past ones, files with parent brokers first, uses the right law for where you live (California's DROP, CCPA/CPRA, GDPR), keeps a removal ledger with scheduled re-scans, shares as little data as possible, and reuses your identity pack from the Vault. Inspired by @SHL0MS's open-source UNBROKER Hermes Agent skill.

name: Tally
one_line_desc: An earnings analyst for your stock watchlist. Every night it writes a brief on who reported, with beats and misses against consensus, guidance changes, management tone and analyst Q\u0026A. Every Monday it builds a verified earnings calendar and previews the week. Facts only, with no trade advice. Not financial advice.

name: Lookout
one_line_desc: Tracks public SEC insider filings, big-fund 13F changes and congressional stock trades for your watchlist, and writes a facts-only nightly brief. For investors who want to see who's buying and selling without guesswork. Not financial advice.

name: FPL Bot
one_line_desc: A Fantasy Premier League assistant that recommends transfers, captain, starting XI and chip timing each gameweek, using official FPL data and team news, with the numbers behind every pick.

name: Mr Beasty
one_line_desc: YouTube script surgeon in the Mr Beast lane. Reviews scripts and cuts anything that kills retention: slow intros, dead jokes, filler and weak payoffs. Built for creators who care about watch time, the first 30 seconds, and whether a stranger would click.

name: Dispatcher
one_line_desc: A dispatcher for lawn care and field-service companies on Service Autopilot. It splits and schedules crew routes, cleans up timesheets, and emails a nightly crew $/hr production report.

name: Tour Guide
one_line_desc: A family travel planner that builds day-by-day trip plans with real, dated prices, watches booking windows, and sends short morning prompts during the trip. You book and pay; it hands you step-by-step checklists.

name: Bot Usage Coach
one_line_desc: Helps Grok Bot users keep usage in check. Reviews your routines and habits, suggests slowing or merging them, and gives each bot a simple tune-up checklist.

name: Unbroker
one_line_desc: Gets your personal info (name, phone, addresses, email, relatives) off people-search sites and data brokers like Spokeo, Whitepages, Intelius, and BeenVerified, then proves each listing is gone and rechecks for relists. You approve once what it may share; it never pays, uploads ID, or sends email in your name without your OK.

name: Local Job Finder
one_line_desc: Finds real, current job openings near you from reputable job boards and employer sites. Search in one line by zip code, county, state, or job title.

name: Blog Draft Writer
one_line_desc: Writes researched, operator-voice WordPress blog drafts on a daily schedule, with AI-generated featured and in-content images. Drafts only, never publishes.

name: Chatter
one_line_desc: X/Twitter sentiment analyst for a Wall Street Research desk. Flags watchlist tickers with ~3x normal morning volume and separates new facts from noise.

name: Meeting Actions
one_line_desc: Paste any meeting notes or transcript and get back who owes what by when: decisions, owners, due dates, open questions, and follow-ups. It never makes up attendees or commitments.

name: Filings
one_line_desc: SEC filings analyst for a Wall Street Research desk: weekday EDGAR diffs of 10-Q/10-K/8-K on your watchlist, material changes only, every claim linked.

name: Content Bot
one_line_desc: A short-form content teammate that layouts, builds, and posts vertical series (sports, streams, tech, beauty, home, movies, luxury, verse) on a weekly calendar — always waiting for your approval before it ships.

name: Options
one_line_desc: Pre-open options flow analyst for a Wall Street Research desk: unusual call volume, IV into earnings, and cash-secured put candidates with source timestamps. Educational research support, not trade advice.

name: Insider
one_line_desc: Tracks SEC Form 4 open-market trades and quarterly 13Fs for a stock watchlist. Flags big insider buys and buy clusters for a research desk.

name: TypingTim
one_line_desc: Get faster at typing with a daily 20-minute Monkeytype plan. TypingTim coaches beginners to 100+ WPM in your own language and keyboard layout, reads your scores, adjusts every session, and keeps a progress dashboard.

name: Earnings
one_line_desc: Night-of earnings analyst for a Wall Street Research desk: guidance vs actuals, new forward numbers, stopped metrics, and dodged questions — with IR and transcript links.

name: Agent Visibility Audit by AgentPay
one_line_desc: Free, read-only visibility audit for AI agent products and paid endpoints. Checks what AI search engines and buyer agents look for, then shows where to fix it.

name: Google Reviews Responder
one_line_desc: Writes warm, on-brand replies to every customer review for local businesses, handles complaints calmly, and summarises what customers love and dislike.

name: Shelfer
one_line_desc: Queues an x.ai/bot template for grokbotshelf.com. Asks for the template author and optional idea credit; can queue a hiccup report without GitHub.

name: Wife Translator
one_line_desc: A just-for-fun, two-way translator for husbands: decode what your wife really means, or turn your blunt guy-speak into something sweet she'll love.

name: Mr. Engineer
one_line_desc: A super engineer that codes alongside Claude Code and Codex CLI, cross-reviewing their work against each other to raise quality. It installs them on its own computer and keeps them updated every weekday.

name: CrimeBeat
one_line_desc: A daily digest of crime and family-safety news near your town, with a map showing where each story happened and a clickable map that links to every article.

name: Tip Stack
one_line_desc: Five verified Grok Bot tips every Tuesday and Thursday, plus a Sunday ranking of marketplace templates that fill real gaps in the bots you already run.

name: Bee
one_line_desc: Bee helps boyfriends and husbands be thoughtful, cycle-aware partners who work only from what she chooses to share. It gives short heads-ups for her harder days and her good weeks, keeps birthdays, anniversaries, and gift ideas, and helps you split chores fairly. Pairs with Honey.

name: Taxman
one_line_desc: A read-only household tax reviewer. It checks your last three years of federal and state returns for errors, missed deductions and credits, withholding gaps, retirement-contribution opportunities, and carryovers, then plans the coming year.

name: Honey
one_line_desc: A private cycle and relationship companion for women. Honey predicts your next period and all four phases, gives discreet heads-ups for the hard days and the good weeks, helps you split chores fairly, and can draft a short note for your partner that you send yourself. Pairs with Bee.

name: Wellbeing
one_line_desc: A warm wellbeing coach that helps you track and improve the areas of health you pick, such as haircare, skincare, diet, sleep, mental health and fitness. It asks specific questions, keeps daily logs, spots patterns and suggests small changes.

name: Source Check
one_line_desc: Paste a headline or screenshot. I find the original video, quote or document and tell you if it matches. Neutral.
Templates you add from other people don't update themselves. Tell + which ones you added and it watches X every week, sending you the new share link when a creator ships an update.

name: Room Inventory Bot
one_line_desc: Send photos of your rooms and get back a private inventory of your key items with estimated values, in chat, as an HTML page and as a PDF. Great for insurance, moving and estate planning.

name: Barren Wuffet
one_line_desc: Weekday Wall Street Research synthesizer: cross-flags specialist notes, ranks what could move a stock, and delivers a short sourced pre-open brief by 6:30 — or one quiet line.

name: Project Portfolio Scanner
one_line_desc: Scan any X account for project and campaign posts, then build a shareable portfolio: totals for impressions, likes and comments, campaigns by category, and a suggested rate card.

name: Weather Alert Bot
one_line_desc: Sends a short morning and evening forecast every day from National Weather Service data, leading with any active watches or warnings for your area.

name: Professor Forge
one_line_desc: AI career instructor. Builds hireable proof for paid AI work: skills you can defend, projects you can rebuild, and certs that match the lane — not trivia.

name: Ladle
one_line_desc: A household cook and meal planner that turns what's already in your fridge and pantry into safe, cheap dinners and shopping lists. Treats allergies as hard blocks and never orders or buys anything without your OK.
